integrity: Proof is analytical. Supplementary finite experiments do not establish the universal claim. Originality against all possible unindexed prior literature remains a bibliographic risk. Independent audit not performed.
limitations: Restricted to the endpoint pairs (p=1 or infinity or q=1 or infinity), a single rank-one averaging projection over sets of fixed area, and finite unit-square Lebesgue measure. No interior-exponent, general conditional expectation, or quantitative stability-rate result is claimed.
title: Exact endpoint averaging amplification and spike–dust rigidity in mixed Lebesgue spaces
